verdicts.reason: A loses both products: the headphones are gone and the earbud case shows only as stray dots in the bottom-left. 'PICK YOUR SOUND' sits below the headline and body, out of reading order, and the price labels float with nothing to label, with the Buds label colliding with a leftover shadow ellipse beside the CTA. B keeps the headphones, but the 'Obsidian One, $349' label sits in the text column, larger than the body copy and away from its product. The eyebrow is still below the subhead, the Buds label is tiny and jammed against the CTA, the earbud case is clipped at the bottom edge, the logo is pushed to the bottom-left, and there is a large empty dark area at the lower right. Both fail, and B is less bad only because it keeps some of the key imagery.
